t: This entry is the Commonwealth of England, the republic that lasted from 1649 to 1660. It followed the Second English Civil War and the trial and execution of Charles I, and the Rump Parliament declared it on the nineteenth of May 1649. Power sat mainly with Parliament and a Council of State. Henry Wise, the gardener, was born in this period, in 1653. He trained at Brompton Nursery and later worked with George London on gardens at Hampton Court, Chatsworth and Castle Howard.
